featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 创建或升级 NSH 工程时可直接使用官方 0.7.0 运行时、匹配 CLI 与两套原样官方 Skills，界面翻译、异步核心状态、多窗口关闭及托盘恢复均改用官方能力，并补充 nshm 与 nsh-extra 准入说明。旧版 NSH 工程须先完成原仓迁移再接入。
featureOptimizations.en-US: When creating or upgrading NSH projects, use the official 0.7.0 runtime, matching CLI, and unmodified official skills. Interface localization, asynchronous core state, multi-window close behavior, and tray restoration now use official APIs, with guidance for adopting nshm and nsh-extra. Older NSH projects must migrate in place before adopting this template.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级 Tauri 知识库宿主与前端候选下界（Tauri 2.12.7、Mantine 9.8.2、TanStack Query 5.108.4、i18next 27 / react-i18next 18、Vite 8.3.8 等），同时保留连续 Node >=24.0.0 与 peer 兼容线；macOS 系统通知设置跳转改用官方 Rust-only tauri-plugin-opener，替代手写 /usr/bin/open 子进程调用并保持零 WebView 越权权限。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Upgraded Tauri host and frontend dependency candidates (Tauri 2.12.7, Mantine 9.8.2, TanStack Query 5.108.4, i18next 27 / react-i18next 18, Vite 8.3.8, and related tooling) while preserving continuous Node >=24.0.0 and peer compatibility lines. macOS notification settings recovery now uses the official Rust-only tauri-plugin-opener instead of spawning /usr/bin/open directly, with no WebView ACL exposure.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 为代码重构、边界审查和升级完整性核对补充下游实战参考，明确状态所有权、依赖方向、运行时版本配对及下游差异回流边界，帮助维护者在不偏离既定边界的情况下安全整理工程结构。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added downstream engineering references to refactoring, boundary review, and upgrade completeness checks, clarifying state ownership, dependency direction, runtime version pairing, and feedback boundaries when cleaning up project structure.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 清理依赖登记快照中 9 个已无活动引用的历史孤儿 Rust crate、删除过时的 Tauri 平台重定向占位文档并收窄多处脚本冗余导出；同步补充 Node 25/26 运行 Vitest 4 + jsdom 29 时的 --no-experimental-webstorage 兼容说明，避免内置实验性存储遮蔽测试环境。
bugFixes.en-US: Removed 9 unused legacy Rust crates from the dependency catalog, deleted the obsolete Tauri platform redirect stub, and removed redundant internal script exports. Added compatibility guidance for running Vitest 4 and jsdom 29 on Node 25/26 with --no-experimental-webstorage to prevent built-in experimental storage from shadowing test globals.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级已有项目时，可先使用 inventory 查看当前上游适用的工程资产、缺失文件和需要复核的本地差异；自有 NSH 入口也会列明兼容限制。
featureOptimizations.en-US: When upgrading an existing project, use inventory to list applicable upstream engineering assets, missing files, and local differences that need review. Custom NSH entry points also report compatibility limits.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复升级候选遗漏 Skill、发布规范或升级器模块仍能通过检查的问题，并明确区分部分同步与完整升级，防止遗漏文件被误判为上游删除。
bugFixes.en-US: Upgrade checks now reject candidates that omit applicable skills, release rules, or upgrader modules. Reports distinguish partial synchronization from a complete upgrade, and omitted files are no longer mistaken for upstream removals.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: NSH 或 Tauri 桌面打包完成后，可直接在项目根 release/ 获取按“应用名_版本号_arch_setup for 系统”命名的安装包；NSH macOS 使用 DMG，Windows 使用官方 EXE。
featureOptimizations.en-US: After packaging an NSH or Tauri desktop app, find the installer directly in the project's release/ directory, named “App_Version_arch_setup for OS”; NSH uses DMG on macOS and the official EXE on Windows.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复候选构建和 CI 绕过测试范围、运行整套回归的问题。现在按上一同渠道版本的变化提供明确测试计划；缺少范围、零命中或测试失败时立即停止。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed candidate builds and CI bypassing test scope and running the full regression suite. Builds now require an explicit test plan for changes since the previous release in the same channel, and stop on missing scope, zero matches, or failed tests.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 NSH 非桌面候选读取新版差异测试证据时仍要求旧 JUnit 文件的问题，避免因证据格式不匹配而无法验收。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed non-desktop NSH candidates requiring a legacy JUnit file when reading the new scoped regression evidence, preventing acceptance from being blocked by the evidence format.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 维护 Harness 或开发新建 NSH 工程时，请在测试命令中指定受影响的文件或用例。省略选择器会在启动测试前退出，运行全量回归须提供本次人工授权引用。既有 NSH 工程升级后可按运行时说明迁移测试别名。
bugFixes.en-US: When maintaining Harness or developing a newly generated NSH project, select the affected test files or cases. Commands without selectors exit before running tests. A full regression run requires a reference to current human authorization. Existing NSH projects can migrate their test scripts after upgrading by following the runtime guide.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在 NSH 下游构建 macOS 或 Windows 正式候选后，可直接从 release/ 取包和对应的 SHA-256 文件。同一目录可保留多个构建，按文件名中的 buildRun 找到对应证据。
featureOptimizations.en-US: After building an NSH macOS or Windows release candidate, find the package and its SHA-256 file directly in release/. Multiple builds can coexist. Use the buildRun in the filename to find its evidence.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 验收时按相同渠道前后两次发布的变化和直接影响选场景，首发按已批准的范围执行。可复用构建阶段的全量单元测试结果。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Choose acceptance scenarios from changes and directly affected behavior since the previous release on the same channel. For a channel’s first release, use its approved scope. Reuse the complete unit test results from the build.

bugFixes.zh-CN: NSH 已启用 updater 时，官方更新归档按原名保留在对应批次的 updates/ 证据目录。平铺发布被中断时，可按 buildRun 恢复该批次。生成本地知识文档也不会使已发布候选的验收失效。
bugFixes.en-US: When the NSH updater is enabled, its official archives keep their names in the build evidence’s updates/ directory. Recover an interrupted flat publication by buildRun. Generating local knowledge reports no longer invalidates an already published candidate.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 升级时会检查验收和打包入口所需文件是否齐全。验收可识别旧发布记录，并在就绪复核中拦住标签、渠道不匹配或尚未通过验收的候选。
bugFixes.en-US: Upgrades check for the files needed by acceptance and packaging. Acceptance recognizes older release records, and readiness checks reject candidates with a mismatched tag or channel or without accepted status.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 任务交付前会清理本次生成且已不再使用的临时测试文件和构建中间产物。最终安装包、验收记录和共享 Cargo 缓存继续保留。这项规则也会随新建项目的任务入口下发。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Before handing off a task, clean up temporary test files and build intermediates created by that task when they are no longer in use. Keep final installers, verification records, and shared Cargo caches. New projects include this rule in their task instructions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新建 NSH 项目使用官方 0.6.1 和同版本开发与设计指南。已有 NSH 项目请先同步 Cargo 运行时、CLI 和项目命令，再使用新版 Harness。
featureOptimizations.en-US: New NSH projects use official NSH 0.6.1 and its matching development and design guides. For existing NSH projects, update the Cargo runtime, CLI, and project commands before using this Harness version.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Rust 构建按执行设备的实际工具链选择原生目标，并复用用户级 Cargo 输出目录。仅通过 Cargo 配置文件设置目录时，NSH 开发脚本和打包命令也能使用该目录。
bugFixes.en-US: Rust builds select the native target from the device’s active toolchain and reuse the user-level Cargo output directory. NSH development and packaging commands also work when the directory is set only in Cargo’s configuration file.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 默认在当前 checkout 完成任务。需要独立环境时，请明确开启 Task 工作树，或在已允许内部 Worktree 的项目中明确请求本次使用。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Tasks use the current checkout by default. Enable Task worktrees when you need a separate checkout, or explicitly request one for internal work in a project that allows it.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 普通构建和发布后本地打包默认生成当前系统的原生产物。需要其他系统、架构或 Web 时，请明确指定目标。运行测试与验收在对应环境完成。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Builds and post-release packaging default to the current operating system and native architecture. Specify the target when you need a different system, architecture, or a Web build. Runtime tests and acceptance run in the corresponding environment.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Rust 构建沿用全局 Cargo 目录。使用共享目录打包 Tauri Linux 试包时，Harness 按本次构建报告的路径查找 deb。
bugFixes.en-US: Rust builds use Cargo’s global output directory. For a Tauri Linux test build using that shared directory, Harness locates the deb at the path reported by the current build.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新建 NSH 桌面、移动、Web 或终端项目时，使用 NSH 0.6.0 CLI。模板自动安装同版本的官方开发和设计指南。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use the NSH 0.6.0 CLI to create desktop, mobile, web, or terminal projects. The template installs the matching official development and design guides.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 维护已有 NSH 工程时，使用 0.5.0、0.5.1 或旧 GUI/NSH 格式的项目须先迁移到 0.6.0 的顶层 Mixed 工程，再使用新版开发命令、Harness 升级或打包入口。开发命令会在启动前检查 CLI 版本。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Migrate projects on NSH 0.5.0 or 0.5.1 and projects using the legacy GUI/NSH format to a top-level Mixed workspace on 0.6.0 before using the current development commands, Harness upgrade, or packaging. Development commands check the CLI version before launch.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: NSH 桌面项目启用关于页后，可展开和收起随应用提供的离线双语更新日志，辅助技术可以读取展开状态。
featureOptimizations.en-US: NSH desktop projects with an About page can expand and collapse the bundled bilingual release notes offline. The control exposes its expanded state to assistive technology.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 从 README 或 AGENTS.md 打开项目 Skills 索引，按任务查找适用入口。新建 NSH 项目的 Skills 地图也会链接到项目内安装的官方开发 Skill 和设计指南。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Open the project Skills index from README or AGENTS.md to find the right entry for each task. New NSH projects also link to the official development Skill and design guide installed in the project.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 准备交付时，可按目标查找 Git 发布、本地试包、正式候选或验收入口。撰写双语更新日志时，说明用户如何使用改进、修复后会看到什么结果，并用可比较的实测支持性能数字。
featureOptimizations.en-US: When preparing a delivery, find the guide for a Git release, a local test package, a release candidate, or acceptance. When writing bilingual release notes, describe how to use improvements and what users will see after a fix, and support performance figures with comparable measurements.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 新建项目完成初始化时，按完整名称裁剪 Skill 引用，避免误伤名称相近的入口。非 NSH 项目的 Harness 升级预览会拦截不适用的 NSH 官方 Skills。
bugFixes.en-US: When a new project finishes initialization, pruning matches complete Skill names so entries with similar names stay intact. Harness upgrade previews for projects without NSH block inapplicable official NSH Skills.

bugFixes.zh-CN: NSH 验收指南明确按选定的构建批次核对审查记录。已选或必需场景缺少运行证据，或缺少渠道要求的签名时，该批次判为拒绝。
bugFixes.en-US: The NSH acceptance guide now specifies how to check the review record for the selected build batch. The batch is rejected if it lacks runtime evidence for a selected or required scenario or lacks required channel signing.
